<set-variable name="correlation-id" value="@{
      var tp = context.Request.Headers.GetValueOrDefault("traceparent", "");
      var parts = tp.Split('-');
      if (parts.Length == 4 && parts[1].Length == 32) { return parts[1]; }
      var given = context.Request.Headers.GetValueOrDefault("x-atlas-correlation-id", "");
      if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(given) && given.Length <= 64) { return given; }
      return context.RequestId.ToString("N");
  }" />
  
    @((string)context.Variables["correlation-id"])
